SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.hint: Each test that fails waits for the next period. Medication or magical treatment −1 TN, intensive psychotherapy (Hospitalized lifestyle) −2, a sustained spell a further −1.
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.hintPhobia: Cyberphobia: recovery begins only once the decker is medicated or under magical treatment (VR2 p. 49). Medication −1 TN, psychotherapy (Hospitalized lifestyle) −2, a sustained spell a further −1.
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.hintJudas: Judas: recovery begins only once the companions have found the compulsion out and stop the decker (VR2 p. 49). Medication −1 TN, psychotherapy (Hospitalized lifestyle) −2, a sustained spell a further −1.
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.hintConditioning: Positive conditioning: +1 TN for the counter-conditioning (VR2 p. 50). Medication −1 TN, psychotherapy (Hospitalized lifestyle) −2, a sustained spell a further −1.
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.title: Recovering from a psychotropic effect
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.spell: Under a sustained, locked or quickened spell (−1 TN)
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.caught: The companions caught the compulsion and stop it
SR2E.MxLife97.Psyche.gone: That psychotropic effect is no longer on the decker.

SR2E.MxLife97.Why.phobiaUntreated: Cyberphobia: recovery begins only under medication or magical treatment (VR2 p. 49).
SR2E.MxLife97.Why.judasUncaught: Judas: recovery begins only once the companions have caught the compulsion and stop the decker (VR2 p. 49).

SR2E.MxLife97.Why.formOperational: An operational utility can't be a complex form: otaku use their channels (and channel specializations) for those (otaku errata, entry 6).
SR2E.MxLife97.Why.formHardening: Hardening is part of the living persona, not a complex form (otaku errata, entry 5).
SR2E.MxLife97.Why.formAboveComputer: A complex form's rating may not exceed the otaku's Computer Skill (VR2 p. 145).

SR2E.MxLife97.Form.underWay: {name} begins programming {form}: size {size} Mp, base {base} days, Computer against TN {tn}, successes {s}, otaku task bonus {bonus}: ready in {days} days (VR2 p. 145).
SR2E.MxLife97.Form.done: {name} programs {form} into the living persona: size {size} Mp, base {base} days, Computer against TN {tn}, successes {s}, otaku task bonus {bonus}: {days} days of work (VR2 p. 145).
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__psychRe: Psychotropic recovery: a Willpower (IC rating) test every week (Matrix maniac every day), treatment modifiers, rolled from a GM card on the world clock, VR2 p. 50 (book) or the GM clears the effect by hand (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__paydata: Paydata going stale: a decker's unsold Paydata Points drop by 1 a day (the GM's story files are left alone), VR2 p. 65 (book) or they keep (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__cookIns: Deck parts: Cook and Installation tasks after the design, each base time ÷ successes, VR2 pp. 77, 82–88 (book) or the design's days only (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__otakuCh: Otaku channels as skills: Karma as a Willpower-linked active skill, no MPCP cap, VR2 p. 144 and otaku errata (book) or rating × Karma at most MPCP (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__complex: Complex forms: at most the Computer Skill, no operational utilities, a programming task with the otaku task bonus, VR2 p. 145 and otaku errata (book) or learned at once, at most MPCP (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__otakuAr: Otaku's free Armor: the living persona soaks with Armor = Willpower unless a better Armor is loaded, VR2 p. 145 (book) or only a loaded Armor utility (v965)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.MXLIFE_V97__icToken: IC on the Matrix scene: launched IC gets a hidden token beside its host's token on the GM's viewed scene (scene) or no token (v965, a table convenience)
